final: WITH g AS (SELECT ma.player_id AS pid, p.death_country AS dc, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country), t AS (SELECT dc, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g GROUP BY dc) SELECT g.pid, g.dc, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS ratio FROM g JOIN t ON g.dc = t.dc ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
